We use only storage that is necessary for the platform to work. We do not use analytics or third-party tracking cookies. Clearly labelled sponsored insurance advertisements may appear in designated page slots; they are not selected using tracking cookies. We do not share this data with anyone.

What we store

- A session cookie, which keeps your browser connected to the server while you use the site
- A sign-in token, stored in your browser, which keeps you logged in between visits
- A small record that you have seen the cookie notice, so it is not shown again

Because all of this is strictly necessary to provide the service you asked for, we do not ask for consent to use it. You can clear this storage at any time through your browser settings, though doing so will sign you out.
